description: Jay's Moondoggie Spa in New Columbia, Pennsylvania is a full-service dog grooming salon owned and operated by Jay DiGangi-Roush, who brings over 50 years of experience in the pet industry including breeding, showing, and previous ownership of kennels and grooming facilities. The salon offers bathing, full grooming with customized cuts and trims, nail care, ear and eye cleaning, and behavioral training services, with pricing that varies based on coat condition, dog size, and effort required. Jay works to make grooming a positive experience for all dogs, including those anxious about the process, and welcomes scheduling by phone or online.
